title: How a release branch works
subtitle: Freezing a release while main keeps moving

scenes.title: Release 2.4
scenes.narration: When we get ready to ship, we split off a release branch. Main keeps getting new features, while the release branch only gets fixes, shown as squares. Once the release ships, its fixes are merged back into main, so they are not lost. An urgent fix to the live version gets its own short branch the same way.

scenes.title: One release week
scenes.narration: Most of a release week goes into testing the frozen branch, and fixing what testing finds. Writing the notes and merging back take only a few hours.
